title: PLS Group 2026 Annual Report incorporating Appendix 4E
summary: PLS reported FY2026 revenue of AUD2.017 billion, underlying EBITDA of AUD1.137 billion, AUD809 million NPAT, 879.5kt production, AUD2.290 billion cash, and a 5-cent final dividend; the audited report also documents debt, leases, reserves and project risks.
